title: Bounding μT for Noninvertible-Feedback TtP Constructions
summary: Prior bounds cover invertible-feedback TtP constructions; after an Ascon-specific analysis, a useful upper bound on μT for generic noninvertible-feedback cases such as keyed Sponge Duplex remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine a useful upper bound on the quantity $\mu_T$ for Transform-then-Permute (TtP) constructions with a noninvertible decryption feedback function, particularly keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon constructions; bounding $\mu_T$ under this condition remains open.

scope.domain: Security analysis of noninvertible-feedback Transform-then-Permute authenticated-encryption constructions, especially keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon.
parameters: μ_T — the quantity for which a useful upper bound is sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish a useful upper bound on μ_T for noninvertible-feedback TtP constructions; the generic keyed Sponge Duplex case remains unresolved after the Ascon-specific analysis.

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents bounding μ_T for noninvertible-feedback TtP constructions, including keyed Sponge Duplex and Ascon, as an open problem for future research. Its Ascon-specific analysis does not settle the generic keyed Sponge Duplex case.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Exact Security Analysis of ASCON
